phase_label: Pentest Specialist Runtime & Budget Reliability Closure
note: Reliability closure, not success-rate forcing. The goal is to eliminate avoidable runtime / tool-decode / budget-accounting / search-budget failures so remaining failures represent real search/exploit capability. Phase 3E denominator is untouched; no oracle/verifier/CompletionVerifier/prompt change.

root_cause_summary.tool_decode: autopenbench_adapter/environment.py subprocess.run(text=True) raised UnicodeDecodeError on invalid UTF-8 target output, crashing the MCP tool and killing the run (Phase 3E vm1 rep2).
root_cause_summary.tool_turn_exhaustion: openai_compatible.py raised a generic provider AgentRunError at max tool turns, so genuine budget exhaustion looked like an infra crash and could not be recovered or honestly classified (4 Phase 3E + 5 control runs).
root_cause_summary.search_budget_starvation: search_budget.grant() capped ALL hypotheses (including goal-directed EXPLOIT) at ordinary_hypothesis_max_consecutive_turns=3, and TEST hypotheses drained the high_priority_reserve so the global 30-turn budget ran out before EXPLOIT was scheduled (Phase 3F-A vm2).

changes.change: bytes-safe subprocess capture; deterministic safe-decode; raw artifact + SHA-256 persisted; decode_error diagnostic recorded; never crashes on invalid UTF-8.
max tool turns yields honest TurnCompleted(stop_reason=error_max_turns) instead of raising; loop classifies max_turns / tool_turn_exhausted and attempts StructuredOutput recovery.

goal-directed kinds (exploit/verify/recover) protected by high_priority_reserve with kind-based consecutive cap (EXPLOIT=9 etc.); exploratory kinds (discover/enumerate/test) capped to ordinary budget; machine-readable grant ledger added to snapshot().
pass _EXECUTOR_TURN_BUDGETS as the goal-directed consecutive-turn cap.
auditable taxonomy mapping (tool_turn_exhausted, search_budget_exhausted, tool_decode_error, target_connection_error, provider/model_error, command_timeout, exploit_*).

budget_accounting_before.per_run_budget_ledger: global snapshot only (per-run grants not recorded)
